prompt:
电商促销活动图。核心任务：让用户快速理解活动利益点并产生即时购买动机。受众：{由用户输入，或根据商品和活动资料总结}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据活动资料总结}。文案：{只使用用户提供的核对过的文案}。商品主体：{由用户指定、参考图识别或商品资料提取}。活动机制：{从用户资料中提取折扣、满减、赠品、组合、限时等真实活动信息}。活动时间与限制：{仅使用用户明确提供的信息}。其余促销氛围、视觉重点和画面表现请自主完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。

本次输入：【填写商品外观、图的用途、已核对的规格与可展示文案】。
有事实、名称、数字或引文时，按输入使用；信息缺失的模块留空或省略。
promptEnglish:
E-commerce promotion and sales event image. Core task: Enable users to immediately grasp promotional benefits and generate purchase intent. Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on product and campaign data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on campaign data}. Copy: {Use only approved copy supplied by the user}. Product subject: {Specified by user, recognized from reference image, or extracted from product data}. Campaign mechanics: {Extract genuine discount, tiered reduction, gifts, bundles, or limited-time campaign rules from user data}. Campaign dates and limits: {Use only explicitly provided user info}. Autonomously design promotional atmosphere, focal points, and visual presentation. Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

Inputs: [Provide product appearance, purpose of the image, verified specifications, and approved copy].
Use supplied facts, names, numbers and quotations. Leave sections without data blank or omit them.
